title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-purchase outings on campus and around Lakeland, from public art galleries and gardens to interactive history and nature spaces.

cards.title: Browse the Melvin and Burks Galleries
cards.subtitle: See rotating professional and student exhibitions on the Florida Southern campus.
cards.notes: Bring a classmate, compare favorite works, and leave time for both galleries; visit while the College is in session.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art break featuring changing exhibitions and student showcases.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College states that the Melvin and Burks Galleries are free and open to the public, with no admission charge for gallery events.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-4:30 PM, when Florida Southern College is in session.

cards.entity_name: Ashley Gibson Barnett Museum of Art
cards.title: Explore the AGB Museum’s Galleries
cards.subtitle: Walk through rotating exhibitions near Florida Southern College and downtown Lakeland.
cards.notes: Choose one gallery to explore slowly, then trade observations with a friend before moving to the next exhibition.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission museum outing centered on rotating art exhibitions and shared conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern College identifies the Ashley Gibson Barnett Museum of Art as a nearby museum with free admission and rotating exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Public museum access is free; consult the museum’s current schedule before departing because gallery hours can change.

cards.title: Take a Hollis Garden Photo Walk
cards.subtitle: Follow the garden rooms beside Lake Mirror and compare plants, textures, and views.
cards.notes: Meet at the Orange Street entrance, pick a color or plant theme, and share five photos at the end of your loop.
cards.short_summary: A free botanical walk with structured garden rooms and Lake Mirror scenery.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lakeland says Hollis Garden is a 1.2-acre botanical garden, is accessible to all, and has free admission.
cards.access_notes: The official city page lists Hollis Garden at 702 E Orange Street and confirms free public admission; check posted garden hours.

cards.title: Trace Lakeland’s Citrus Story
cards.subtitle: Explore a self-guided local-history exhibit inside the Lakeland Public Library.
cards.notes: Start with the early-groves displays, listen to an oral-history reflection, and compare notes on how citrus shaped the city.
cards.short_summary: An interactive, self-paced look at the people, marketing, and groves behind Lakeland’s citrus history.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lakeland describes “From the Groves… Lakeland’s Citrus Story” as a free, self-guided, interactive exhibit.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9:00 AM-7:00 PM, Friday-Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM, and Sunday 1:30-5:00 PM.

cards.title: Walk a Bonnet Springs Park Loop
cards.subtitle: Link free trails, gardens, playgrounds, and lakeside scenery west of downtown.
cards.notes: Meet at the Welcome Center, choose a comfortable loop from the park map, and carry water for the exposed sections.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, admission-free park circuit through 168 acres of nature and recreation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonnet Springs Park states that the 168-acre urban-nature park is open daily with free admission and offers trails, gardens, and playgrounds.
cards.source_title: Bonnet Springs Park - Escape. Engage. Explore.
cards.access_notes: Park gates currently open at 6:00 AM and close at 8:00 PM; special events may have separate terms.

cards.title: Cross the Crenshaw Canopy Walk
cards.subtitle: Walk above the oak grove at admission-free Bonnet Springs Park.
cards.notes: Pause at overlooks, scan the canopy for wildlife, and keep the group together without blocking the elevated walkway.
cards.short_summary: An elevated social walk through the tree canopy in Bonnet Springs Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonnet Springs Park’s current FAQ names the Crenshaw Canopy Walkway and confirms that the park charges no admission except where noted for special events.
cards.access_notes: Enter during park gate hours; attractions can have narrower operating windows. Pets are not permitted on the walkway.

cards.title: Meet Up at the Kiwanis Treehouse
cards.subtitle: Explore an accessible raised treehouse inside Bonnet Springs Park.
cards.notes: Use the treehouse as a group meetup, explore its elevated setting, and yield space if a scheduled program is underway.
cards.short_summary: A playful, admission-free gathering point raised among the park’s oak trees.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonnet Springs Park’s FAQ identifies the Kiwanis Cares for Kids Treehouse and states that general park admission is free unless noted for special events.
cards.access_notes: General park entry is free; the treehouse may be unavailable during reservations or programs. Pets are not permitted inside.

cards.title: Compare Notes at the Nature Center
cards.subtitle: Study local plants, animals, and water systems inside Bonnet Springs Park.
cards.notes: Pick one exhibit theme per person, then regroup outside and explain one surprising ecological connection you noticed.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative nature-learning stop within Lakeland’s admission-free urban park.
cards.evidence_claim: The park FAQ identifies the Nature Center as a staffed park building and confirms that Bonnet Springs Park does not charge general admission.
cards.access_notes: The Nature Center’s interior is available only when staff are present; general park entry remains free.

cards.title: Walk or Roll the Circulator
cards.subtitle: Follow Bonnet Springs Park’s marked shared route at an easy group pace.
cards.notes: Choose a turnaround point before starting, follow posted speed limits, and use the route’s distance markers to track progress.
cards.short_summary: A free marked route for a conversational walk, run, or low-speed ride around the park.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonnet Springs Park confirms that low-speed cycling is allowed on the Circulator, that it has distance markers, and that park admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Use the Circulator during gate hours and obey posted speed limits; wheeled devices are restricted from smaller paths and boardwalks.

cards.title: Read the StoryWalk Together
cards.subtitle: Follow book pages along a nature path near the Crenshaw Canopy Walk.
cards.notes: Take turns reading each sign aloud, pause to notice nearby nature details, and let faster groups pass between pages.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided combination of shared reading, light walking, and outdoor observation.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonnet Springs Park describes StoryWalk as a self-guided walk with book pages along a path and lists the host park as open with free admission.
cards.access_notes: The StoryWalk page lists park gates from 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM; participation uses the posted signs and requires no purchase.
